- New app icon: a banded Jupiter with Ganymede in orbit and a play button, on a deep indigo sky. It's an adaptive vector icon, so it fits any launcher shape, and it supports Android 13+ themed (monochrome) icons.

Installs over v1.1.0 and later directly. If you're still on v1.0.0, uninstall it first; it was signed with a different key.
